note: Verify word ending in 'ses' such as 'cases' and 'houses' produces correct singular instead of stripping 'es' with word[:-2].
Verify that exp.Count with exp.Star correctly becomes CountIf using cond.copy() without losing DISTINCT or WithinGroup behavior.
Check whether urllib.parse.urlsplit(direct_url.url).scheme handles uppercase, missing, and relative schemes when dir_info is present.
Verify that _internal_output StringIO contents are copied back to output_stream after core.process() when output_stream.seekable() is false.
Check whether _internal_output equals output_stream via != versus is not causes missed or duplicate output_stream.write when streams compare equal.
Verify iter_index respects stop when None, negative, or beyond iterable length and yields correct indexes for value after start.
Verify iter_index defines stop parameter otherwise islice(iterable, start, stop) raises NameError on non-indexable iterables.
Verify that seq_index(value, i + 1, stop) correctly stops yielding when stop bounds exclude later occurrences and handles negative/out-of-range stop.
Verify that version strings like empty, '.' or '1..2' passing _SIMPLE_VERSION_INDICATORS check still raise InvalidVersion via _release parsing.
Verify that bypassing cache when renderer is not a str and normalizing plugins to plugins_key prevents __cached_parsers cross-call mutation.
Verify that __bool__ calling peek() without advancing _index leaves _cache and _source unchanged when peek pulls via next(self._source).
Verify resetting self._index to None on IndexError and returning default vs raising on StopIteration when default is _marker.
Verify DOMAIN_REGEX lookahead (?=.{1,253}$) correctly counts total length including trailing dot and rejects overlong domains without breaking valid ones.
